Your black-and-cream flyer is ready, at 4:5 (free plan size, 640px on the long side):

How I made it:
- The image generator can't make 4:5 images, so I first made a plain cream background. Then I used the image editor to make it 4:5 and add the text.
- I asked for black serif text on cream, centred, with only these four parts and no other words:
  - Printmakers' Open Studio
  - 9 October 2027
  - 11:00–17:00
  - The address on four lines: "Unit 14B, Second Floor," / "The Old Foundry Arts Centre," / "127–129 St. John's Road," / "Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB"

I couldn't preview the finished image here, so I haven't been able to check the text myself. AI image models sometimes get small characters wrong, so please check it closely before you print: the apostrophes, the en dashes in "11:00–17:00" and "127–129", the full stop in "St.", and "KT1 2AB". If anything is wrong or missing, tell me and I'll make it again. That costs 10 credits each time; this flyer used 20 credits in total.
